name: OpenAI Agents SDK Runtime
mechanism: Provides a lightweight runner for tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, serialized approvals, streaming, usage accounting and trace emission.
use_when: A Python application needs a small conventional agent SDK with sessions and approvals
OpenAI Responses integration is preferred while third-party model adapters remain optional
avoid_when: Durable multi-day recovery is required without an additional workflow integration
Default trace export or provider coupling conflicts with governance requirements
expected_effects: Reduced custom code for agent turns, sessions and approval state
failure_modes: Session history is mistaken for durable side-effect recovery
Sensitive trace data is exported under unsafe defaults
Provider or hosted-tool assumptions leak into application design
required_evals: durable integration crash and duplicate-effect tests
